films.title: Iphigenia
films.description: Cacoyannis films the Aulis sacrifice that the Cypria made central — the stalled fleet and the daughter traded for a wind to Troy.

music.title: Iphigénie en Aulide
music.description: Gluck's reform opera stages the Cypria's Aulis crisis — Agamemnon, the goddess's demand, and the child who must die before the ships sail.

popCulture.title: Cypria
popCulture.description: The lost Epic Cycle prequel to the Iliad — Judgment of Paris, the suitors' oath, Aulis, and Mysia in eleven vanished books.

popCulture.title: Epic Cycle
popCulture.description: The Trojan hexameter cycle of which the Cypria is the opening poem — the war told before and after Homer.

popCulture.title: Iphigenia in Aulis
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' last Aulis play — the Cypria episode that tragedy kept when the epic itself was lost.
